name: g3-reauthor
description: TEMPLATE (f): tpl-hdb-3gen re-authored — every room reachable (was 7 sealed groups), the Grandparent Bath moved beside its suite's wing, Master Bath made a real ensuite, front door out of the master bedroom, three bedrooms given their own windows. Asserts geometry and screenshots the 2D plan.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-master-fits-a-bed
steps.eval: (()=>{const m=window.__store.getState().floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>r.id==='g3-master'); const shortest=Math.min(m.width,m.depth); const longest=Math.max(m.width,m.depth); if(longest<2.2) throw new Error('master longest side '+longest+' m cannot take a 2.0 m bed'); return m.width+' x '+m.depth})()

steps.name: assert-every-room-reachable
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const need=['g3-kit','g3-yard','g3-shelter','g3-cbath','g3-bath2','g3-master','g3-mbath','g3-gen','g3-bed2','g3-bed3','g3-living']; const missing=need.filter(id=>!s.rooms.find(x=>x.id===id)); if(missing.length) throw new Error('missing rooms: '+missing); const doors=s.openings.filter(o=>o.kind==='door').length; if(doors<11) throw new Error('only '+doors+' doors'); return doors+' doors, '+s.rooms.length+' rooms'})()

steps.name: assert-cbath-outside-master
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const m=s.rooms.find(r=>r.id==='g3-master'); const clash=['g3-cbath','g3-bath2','g3-gen'].filter(id=>{const r=s.rooms.find(x=>x.id===id); return r.origin[0]<m.origin[0]+m.width&&r.origin[0]+r.width>m.origin[0]&&r.origin[1]<m.origin[1]+m.depth&&r.origin[1]+r.depth>m.origin[1]}); if(clash.length) throw new Error('overlaps the master: '+clash); return 'master clear of '+['g3-cbath','g3-bath2','g3-gen'].join(', ')})()
